name: Roman Punch No. 1
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Grate the yellow rind of four lemons and two oranges upon two pounds of loaf sugar
Squeeze the juice of the lemons and oranges and cover it
Let it stand until next day
Strain it through a sieve and mix with the sugar
Add a bottle of champagne and the whites of eight eggs beaten to a stiff froth
It may be frozen or not, as desired
For winter use snow instead of ice

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Grate the yellow rind of four lemons and two oranges upon two pounds of loaf sugar
2. Squeeze the juice of the lemons and oranges and cover it
3. Let it stand until next day
4. Strain it through a sieve and mix with the sugar
5. Add a bottle of champagne and the whites of eight eggs beaten to a stiff froth
6. It may be frozen or not, as desired
7. For winter use snow instead of ice
